description: Power model: P = eta_overall * rho * g * Q * H_net / 1000 (kW); low-head run-of-river plant; Francis/Kaplan turbine parabolic eta curve

unit.name: Generic Run-of-River Hydropower Plant
unit.source: Penche (1998), Layman's Guidebook on How to Develop a Small Hydro Site; IEC 60041

k_efficiency.note: Efficiency drop coefficient for off-design flow

head_loss_fraction.note: Penstock head loss as fraction of gross head
